Treatment summary
Patient presented following a motor veihcle collision in which their vehicle was struck while turning left, reporting right knee
pain at the time of evaluation. The mechanism and force of the impact are consistent with the reported knee injury. No prior
injury to this body area is known to this provider. Over the course of care, the patient attended 25 visits for conservative
management, including physical therapy, activity modification, and anti-inflammatory medication. Treatment followed a typical
progression and was gradually reduced in frequency as symptoms improved. Subjective pain complaints form the basis of most
documented findings, as the patient's report of pain is the primary indicator in this record. Imaging of the knee and standard
orthopedic examination maneuvers returned normal results. Billed services reflect the treatment provided, with no repeated or
duplicate charges identified. Discharge from active care is anticipated pending continued home exercise and follow-up as needed.

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),

  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
